result.instructions: Tools for Dotypos, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What were yesterday's sales per payment type in my main branch?"; "Which products in the main warehouse are down to 5 or fewer units?"; "List all unpaid invoices from this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dotypos data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dotypos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dotypos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dotypos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dotypos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dotypos_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the branches (shops / points of sale) of the connected Dotypos cloud. Use the ids to filter orders, reservations and reports. GET /clouds/{cloud}/branches.

deleted.description: Deleted records: exclude (default), only, or include (both).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: dotypos_get_branch
tools.title: Get branch
tools.description: One branch by id. GET /clouds/{cloud}/branches/{id}.

branch_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

tools.name: dotypos_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories (name, VAT, colour, sort order). GET /clouds/{cloud}/categories.

name.description: Only categories whose name contains this text.

deleted.description: Deleted records: exclude (default), only, or include (both).

sort.description: Sort: attribute names, comma separated, a leading - for descending (e.g. -created,name). Only some attributes sort.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: dotypos_get_category
tools.title: Get category

category_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

tools.name: dotypos_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List or search the product catalog: name, prices with and without VAT, VAT, category, EAN/PLU codes, unit, tags, stock-deduction setting. Filter by name text, category, EAN or PLU code, tag or visibility. GET /clouds/{cloud}/products.

name.description: Only products whose name contains this text (case insensitive).

category_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

ean.description: Only products with this exact EAN code.

plu.description: Only products with this exact PLU code.

displayed.description: true = only products shown at the POS, false = only hidden ones.

deleted.description: Deleted records: exclude (default), only, or include (both).

sort.description: Sort: attribute names, comma separated, a leading - for descending (e.g. -created,name). Only some attributes sort.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

deleted.description: Deleted records: exclude (default), only, or include (both).

sort.description: Sort: attribute names, comma separated, a leading - for descending (e.g. -created,name). Only some attributes sort.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: dotypos_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders and receipts (documents): number, type, status, totals, customer, employee, table, branch, paid flag, created/completed dates. Filter by time, status, type, branch, customer, employee or paid state; newest first by default. Line items are in dotypos_list_order_items. GET /clouds/{cloud}/orders.

created_from.description: Only orders created at or after this moment (ISO 8601).

created_to.description: Only orders created before this moment (ISO 8601, exclusive).

document_type.description: Document type, e.g. RECEIPT or INVOICE.

branch_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

customer_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

employee_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

paid.description: true = only paid orders, false = only unpaid.

sort.description: Sort, e.g. -created (default) or created. Orders are not counted: follow next_page until it is null.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

created_to.description: Only items created before this moment (ISO 8601, exclusive).

tools.name: dotypos_get_sales_report
tools.title: Get sales report
tools.description: The base sales report of one branch for a time range of at most 26 hours (one business day; Dotypos limits a report to 26 hours, so ask for one day at a time): sales and cancel counts and values, revenue with VAT and payment-type breakdown, discounts, cash in/out, sales by category, product, tag, employee and customer, tips and write-offs. For longer periods use dotypos_list_order_items with a time range. GET /clouds/{cloud}/branches/{id}/sales-report.

branch_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

date_from.description: Start of the interval (ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+02:00).

date_to.description: End of the interval (ISO 8601 with a timezone); at most 26 hours after date_from.

vat_payer.description: Report as a VAT payer (default true).

seller_id.description: Count only this seller: the _sellerId field of an employee in dotypos_list_employees (not the employee id). Default: all sellers.

lang.description: 2-letter lowercase language code for names in the report (e.g. en, cs).

tools.name: dotypos_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer record. At least one of first_name, last_name or company_name is required. Creates a new record every time (not idempotent). POST /clouds/{cloud}/customers.

tools.name: dotypos_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one customer; only the fields you pass are changed. The record is read first and updated with its ETag, so a concurrent change makes the update fail instead of overwriting it. PATCH /clouds/{cloud}/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

tools.name: dotypos_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: WRITE: change the name, net price, description or visibility of one product; only the fields you pass are changed. The price with VAT is derived by Dotypos from the net price and the product's VAT. The record is read first and updated with its ETag, so a concurrent change makes the update fail. PATCH /clouds/{cloud}/products/{id}.

product_id.description: Numeric id (as in the replies; default items of a new cloud have negative ids such as -301).

price_without_vat.description: New net price without VAT, in the cloud's currency.

displayed.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the product at the POS.
